selection: Before full scoring, select one complete trajectory in 12 task families absent from v4/v5 development; include available successful families, fill from failed families using seeded RNG. Official outcomes used only for strata, never passed to judge.
limitations: Purposeful, stratified evidence review by primary assistant, not independent human gold or prevalence representative.
current_scope: Same 12 trajectories and 176 steps as previous Chinese full experiment, fixed before English full scoring. Previously reviewed; not unseen or independent human gold.
